messages:
mira: FYI ap-southeast1 showing a new pattern: lots of tiny pods stuck Pending then eviction churn. Evictions ~2x in last 20m.

jon: saw. Kubelet logs show 'attach timeout' and nodes reporting high nf_conntrack_count (~125k/131072).

mira: Workload is fractional-GPU tiny-gang with strict requiredDuringScheduling affinity + hard anti-affinity. Fragmentation => can't pack, scheduler preempts to free nodes.

jon: Quick options: bump nf_conntrack_max on a canary set, temporarily downgrade anti-affinity to preferred for tiny-gang, or add a short-lived warm node.

ops: If you want latency-stable customers, adding +1 warm GPU node for 4h is fastest. Cost vs user impact tradeoff explained in runbook.

mira: Let's do conntrack canary first (10% nodes) then soft-affinity gate if no improvement in 10m. Example sysctl: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`.

infra-bot: INC-2026-999 created: "ap-southeast1 conntrack -> attach limbo -> preempt cascade" assigned to eng-platform.

jon: I'll prepare a small privileged daemonset for the sysctl canary and monitor `conntrack_drops` + `device_attach_duration_ms`.

mira: Also capture fragmentation metric (free_gpu_slots / total_gpu_slots) per AZ and alert when >0.6 — creating ticket SCHED-PL-777.

ops: Standby to spin +1 node if canary doesn't reduce preempts in 12m.

mira: Rolling canary to 10% now, will update with 5m metric snapshot.
